description: Participant has answered the screening questions but has not yet chosen a route. Charges withdrawn — the branch that most clearly survives KRS 17.142(4). No court identity appears: this component is participant-only and is never filed or sent.

eligibilityData.eligibilityBasisNote: No eligibility conclusion is asserted, and no statement is made about whether these records are subject to KRS 431.076 or KRS 431.078. That is the question this component exists to put to the participant.

partyDataFieldNote: partyData uses the PleadingRenderInput field names petitionerName / petitionerAddress / otherNamesUsed. The role label for this track is set by presentation.movantRole in the config (Movant on the void-and-seal tracks, Applicant on the KRS 17.142(2) application), not by the fixture key name.
